# VPN SHOP 1.2.0

This release brings the refreshed Telegram subscription shopping screen to the VPN SHOP server panel.

- A dedicated VPN SHOP purchase banner displays Germany, Netherlands and Albania, each with its national flag.
- Subscription plans are displayed in an interactive three-column table: traffic, duration, price.
- Tapping any cell in a plan row starts the existing purchase flow for that specific plan.
- The displayed prices and quotas always come from plans configured in the reseller panel; no sample prices are hardcoded.
- Color-coded inline Telegram buttons, up to nine plans per page, paging and a back control.
- English/Persian captions and graceful text fallback if Telegram photo upload fails.
- Regression tests for display, sorting, pagination and live callback identifiers.

**Note:** The location badges are storefront branding. Which country each purchased plan uses is controlled by the actual inbound configuration in the panel.
